mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_content (title, content_type, difficulty, content_body, status, version) VALUES (#{title}, #{contentType}, #{difficulty}, #{contentBody}, #{status}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content_type, difficulty, content_body, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM training_content ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT content_id FROM training_plan_content WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY sort_order, content_id

SELECT c.id, c.title, c.content_type, c.difficulty, c.content_body, c.status, c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM training_plan_content pc INNER JOIN training_content c ON c.id = pc.content_id WHERE pc.plan_id = #{planId} AND pc.enabled = TRUE AND c.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY pc.sort_order, c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_plan_content (plan_id, content_id, sort_order, enabled) VALUES (#{planId}, #{contentId}, #{sortOrder}, TRUE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sort_order = #{sortOrder}, enabled = TRUE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM training_plan_content WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND content_id = #{contentId}
